name: Input Sync
description: Calibrate and compensate for delayed keyboard input.

offset-ms.name: Input offset (ms)
offset-ms.description: How late your keyboard presses arrive. Set by the Calibrate button, or adjust manually.

rollback-enabled.name: Enable rollback
rollback-enabled.description: Rewind and re-simulate so keyboard presses land at the right time. Turn off if it causes issues.
